The failure in run #8831 at the build step shows a permission denied error when attempting to create the npm cache directory (`/opt/runner/_cache/npm/_cacache`). The directory `/opt/runner/_cache/npm` is owned by `root`, and the CI process likely does not have write permissions. This is a configuration or environment issue on the runner, possibly related to shared runners having inconsistent or restricted filesystem access. This supports **H1 (Transient infrastructure flakiness)**, as it points to an unstable or misconfigured runner environment. It weakens **H2 (Deliberate interference)** since there is no indication of intentional disruption here. This issue will likely require either fixing the permissions or switching to a dedicated runner with consistent access.
